SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Carb. ac.]
Weight in epigastrium, as though burdened with flatulence ; seeks relief in fruitless eructating, and pressing hand on pit of stomach.
Burning in stomach.
Distress in stomach, with deathly faintness and great sensitiveness to smells.
Empty gone feeling, also with sensation of weight, or with fulness in stomach, and constant desire to swallow.
Soreness in stomach and bowels.
A great deal of pain changing about from stomach to sides, especially right side and chest.
Dyspepsia ; aching in stomach ; diarrhœa, followed by constipation ; colicky pains.
Cancer of stomach.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Carb. ac.]
Uncomfortable feeling across stomach and liver.
Pain in right hypochondrium ; also in iliac region of both sides.
Sharp pain in right hypochonder. θ Remittent autumnal fever.
Soreness of hypochondria < on motion.
Dull pressing pains in hypochondria.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Carb. ac.]
Sinking feeling all over abdomen.
Rumbling and rolling in abdomen, with a sense of distention.
Sensation of distension in abdomen, as if full of wind, but does not pass any.
A burning or digging feeling low down in abdomen.
Frequent occurrence of colic-like pains.
Colic of nursing infants.
Great tenderness over transverse colon.
Bowels feel sore, when walking.
Bowels bloated and full of flatus three hours after a meal.
Rumbling in bowels, feeling as if diarrhœa would come on after walking about.
Flatulence of old age depending on imperfect digestion.
Jolting during riding affects unpleasantly the abdominal organs, which feel hot and sore.
Burning on outside of abdomen.
Abdomen retracted, with constipation. θ Hydrocephalus.
A crampy stitch in left inguinal region while sitting.
Abdominal muscles feel sore.
Itching of lower part of abdomen, as if bitten by something.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Carb. ac.]
Emission of putrid flatus.
Flatulence of old people. θ Dyspepsia.
Fetid odor.
Stool, like thick glue, passed in thin strips, like tape.
Bloody and mucous discharge, appearing like scraping of mucous membrane ; tenesmus. θ Dysentery.
Looseness of bowels, stools of appearance as in bilious diarrhœa.
Watery evacuations, with pain and sick stomach.
Involuntary thin, black stools. θ Collapse.
Involuntary stools of intolerable odor. θ Puerperal fever.
Diarrhœa, with vomiting of everything taken ; desire to drink ; rice-water discharge of very offensive odor, resembling that of rotten eggs. θ Summer complaint.
Diarrhœa, resulting from bad drainage.
Dysentery : bloody, mucous stools, like scrapings ; tenesmus ; tenderness over transverse colon ; tongue dry and coated with thick, yellow fur ; great thirst and high fever ; pulse 110.
Involuntary stools, at night in bed.
Constant ineffectual urging to stool.
Periodical spells of diarrhœa, followed by constipation. θ Hydrocephalus.
Constipation.
Sluggishness of bowels, accompanied by offensive breath.
Great tenderness of rectum.
Disagreeable hot burning sensation in rectum.
Anus itches and feels as if skin was rubbed off.
Hemorrhoids, with tenderness of rectum, also external, sometimes bleeding.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Carb. ac.]
Tired sensation in renal region.
A dark greenish-brown color of urine.
Greenish urine. θ After scarlatina.
Urine scanty and red. θ Scarlatina.
Urine : golden yellow ; grass or olive green ; very dark colored ; black or blackish olive green.
Frequent micturition.
Straining on passing urine.
Urine increased, had a strong smell.
Micturated freely an excessive quantity of saccharine urine ; obliged to void urine three times every night, and no less than a pint each time ; greatly debilitated thereby. θ Diabetes.
Urine contained albumen ; t. θ Meningitis.
While urinating always an involuntary mucous discharge from anus.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Carb. ac.]
Awakened by strong sexual excitement.
Sexual desire very much decreased ; in one case lost for thirteen day.
Sexual organs relaxed and weak, lascivious dreams, with weakening seminal emissions.
Prickling pain through glans penis and urethra.
Intense burning itching of genitals.
Itching of scrotum and inside of thighs > by scratching, but it soon returns.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Carb. ac.]
Pain in region of left ovary, when walking in open air, soon subsiding.
Painful swelling of left ovary. θ Remittent autumnal fever.
Menses irregular.
Menses too profuse, dark color, followed by headache and great nervous irritability.
Menorrhagia : sinking spells, during which she thought she would die, with cold clammy skin, sallow, soapy, bloodless complexion, irritability of stomach, food lies heavy, flatulence, sour belching, fulness in throat, swollen feeling ; constant disposition to swallow, globus hystericus ; alternate diarrhœa and constipation.
Induration of cervix uteri.
Ulceration on cervix uteri ; < after caustics, discharge of fetid, greenish, acrid matter from vagina ; < after menstruation, which was profuse and lasted six to eight days.
Mucous tubercles on labia and inner thighs, with vaginal discharge.
Copious discharge of fetid, greenish, acrid matter from vagina. θ Leucorrhœa.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Carb. ac.]
Vomiting in pregnancy ; great irritability ; violent frontal headache.
Puerperal fever ; high fever alternating with often recurring chills of short duration, followed by profuse sweat with restlessness ; tenderness over uterus and right iliac fossa ; pulse 160 ; diarrhœa, involuntary stools of intolerable odor ; lochia suppressed ; craving for food ; thirst.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Carb. ac.]
Aphonia.
Diphtheria.
Soreness of respiratory organs, with hoarseness.
Hoarseness, with stiff neck.
Hawking of clear white mucus.
Left side of larynx very sore to pressure.
Tickling in throat causing short hacking cough.
Catarrhal croup.
Chronic laryngitis and bronchitis.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Carb. ac.]
(In sick :) Respiration uneven and irregular.
Stertorous respiration.
Difficult respiration, with sense of oppression.
Desire to take long inspirations, with yawning.
Sighing or moaning expirations ; t.
(In sick :) Her breath was hot and feverish.
Shortness of breath on going up hill or up-stairs.
Dyspnœa at night.
   

COUGH. [27] [Carb. ac.]
Constant inclination to cough.
Short, dry, hacking cough, with tickling in throat ; can hardly retain anything on stomach.
Troublesome cough, with foul tenacious expectoration.
Croup-like cough. θ Diphtheria.
Whooping cough, with redness of face, watering of eyes and frontal headache.
Expectoration of a large quantity of thick, whitish mucus.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Carb. ac.]
Dull pain through upper lobes of lungs, afternoon.
Slight uneasy pains in right lung.
Dull aching in left side of chest and abdomen, running around to scapula.
Chest feels as if compressed, or as if a load was pressing in front ; desire to dilate chest.
Tight feeling in both lungs, especially in outer chest.
Feeling of narrowness in chest, as if diaphragm depressed lungs.
Oppression of chest and frontal headache, going from left to right.
Feeling of expansion in lungs and nasal passages, when walking out of doors.
(OBS :) Phthisis pulmonalis.
Gangrene of lung.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Carb. ac.]
Stitches in region of heart.
Bellow murmur over mitral valves ; dyspnœa and palpitation, < at night ; heart < after indiscretion in eating ; must walk very slow on account of heart beating, is exhausted by ascending. θ Organic valvular heart disease, consequent upon inflammatory rheumatism eight years previously.
Violent fever, pulse 130. θ Diphtheria.
Pulse : rapid (120), feeble and flickering ; intermittent, sometimes slow ; feeble and flickering ; small and rapid.
Pulse irregular. θ Hydrocephaloid.
Pulse 160. θ Puerperal fever.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Carb. ac.]
Transient dull pain under left clavicle.
Sensation as of fine electric sparks on sternal end of right clavicle.
Dull pressure under sternum, in region of sixth rib.
(In sick :) Slight tingling along left side of chest.
Cold sweat on chest ; t.
Scirrhous cancer of left breast. Carb. ac., 2d dec., every two hours for two years.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Carb. ac.]
Jerking in left common carotid artery while walking rapidly after dinner.
Twitching in right sterno-cleido-mastoid muscle ; t. θ Meningitis.
Stitching pains in right side of neck.
Drawing in muscles of neck.
Neck feels lame and stiff, when moving head.
Neck very stiff and sore ; feels as if he had taken a bad cold. θ Remittent fever.
Very great sense of weight on neck, with tenderness even to touch, on seventh cervical vertebra.
Glands of neck swollen. θ Diphtheria.
Itching of back of neck and back.
Aching pains in small of back, < when straightening, from jolting when riding, > by pressure.
She has dragging sensation across loins and throughout pelvis.
Boring pains in small of back, with a cold.
Severe pain in lumbo-sacral region, mostly during latter part of night, of long standing.
Soreness of muscles of back and limbs.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Carb. ac.]
Fetid perspiration in armpits.
Pains in right shoulder without suffering from moving arm.
Aching pains in left shoulder, like a toothache, when lying on right side.
Severe rheumatic pains in right shoulder ; feeling as though it would be impossible to raise arm, but when effort was made it aggravated pain but very little. θ Rheumatism.
Drawing pain in left arm, from shoulder and elbow.
Soreness of muscles of right arm.
(In sick :) Tingling, burning and numb feeling down left arm to tips of fingers, followed by dull aching, heavy feeling.
Aching pain in left forearm.
Creeping, shuddering or horripilation in left forearm, running upward.
Constant tired, heavy feeling in left arm.
Twitching of arms, principally right ; t. θ Meningitis.
Contracting pain in palm of right hand.
Sensation as of fine electric sparks on middle finger of l. hand.
Trembling of hands ; cannot write steadily.
Spasmodic flexion of hands on forearms ; t.
Slight lividity of finger tips.
Numbness of skin of hands.
Stiffness and pricking in hand, followed by a pimple on middle finger (where the acid touched), which increased to size of a carbuncle.
Vesicular eruption on hands and all over body, which itches excessively ; > after rubbing, but leaving a burning pain.
Tingling-itching in little finger of right hand, soon after in left.
Pain in second phalangeal joint of middle finger of right hand.
